better.en: You can let the agent remove a catalog tool, with Undo in Catalog until Faber restarts.
better.pt-BR: Você pode permitir que o agente remova uma ferramenta, com Desfazer no Catálogo até reiniciar o Faber.
better.es: Puedes permitir que el agente quite una herramienta, con Deshacer en el Catálogo hasta reiniciar Faber.
better.fr: Vous pouvez autoriser l’agent à retirer un outil, puis l’annuler dans le Catalogue avant de redémarrer Faber.
better.de: Du kannst dem Agenten erlauben, ein Werkzeug zu entfernen und es bis zum Neustart im Katalog wiederherzustellen.

decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-22 | Extend the existing project catalog tool with remove by shipped id through the same store removal and Undo receipt. Removal has its own faber.tools.remove consent; install and switch grants never authorize it. Existing full trust applies only to this reversible self-change, never external permanent deletion. Keep process, turn, mode and audit guards; refuse ambiguous, corrupt or pending copies without repairing them. Catalog preserves an agent removal receipt on entry and shows the existing Undo, restoring the prior on/off state; engine restart expires it as before. Existing conversation kits retain their tools. | AI |
